# VAULT_SERVER

A Vault-compatible server: where it answers, its KV mount, and whether it unseals itself.

<!-- Generated by nix/signature-docs.nix from nix build .#referencePages -->

Canonically `vault`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.vault`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.

| field | type |
| --- | --- |
| address | string |
| autoUnseals | bool |
| kvPath | string |
| kvVersion | one of ["v1", "v2"] |
| tokenSecret | record { key, name, namespace } |
